We also discuss the difference between our approach and the prior token-level collaboration approach Collab (Chakraborty et al., 2025 ) in Appendix 10 . However, it is worth noting that Assumption 4.1 is relatively strong, since it requires a global coverage that must hold for all prefixes, including those that may not appear in the supervised training data. Because the router is trained only on trajectories generated by the expert policy, satisfying this condition requires generalization beyond the observed data.
